verdict.rationale: Slate's docs say it is 'one of the few agents capable of performing integration tests manually' and that it can run shell commands directly with `!`. Together these suggest it can run and exercise an application from the assistant, but nothing documents attaching to or debugging a live running web app. missing for 10: explicit live-app debugging support (browser/devtools or debugger attach, runtime log/network inspection), documentation of how the manual integration testing works against a running web app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
